messages:
maya-prod: @channel Reminder: new Data Residency & Audit Log defaults for Private (VPC / on-prem) are scheduled to go live in 30 days. Summary: default audit-log retention = 90d, extended retention (365d) available as a paid add-on, and by-default we will not forward logs outside customer VPC unless explicitly enabled.

eric-legal: Legal checked the DPA updates. Key points: (1) explicit customer consent required to enable outbound log forwarding, (2) customers can request export/deletion of telemetry within 30 days, (3) attestation artifacts will show configured retention but do not include raw key material.

zoe-csm: What should CSMs tell customers who ask about FedRAMP or long-term retention?

maya-prod: Talk track: default protects residency and is opt-out for export. For FedRAMP/IL5 or >365d retention, route to Security + Sales for a tailored agreement. We will provide an attestation PDF showing the configured controls.

infra-bot: Runbook and internal docs: https://redwood.dev/internal/runbooks/private-data-residency (internal).

maya-prod: CLI examples for admins who script upgrades:
```bash
# keep audit logs default (90d)
redwood private update --deployment prod-eu --audit-retention 90d

# enable extended audit retention (requires billing add-on)
redwood private update --deployment prod-eu --audit-retention 365d --billing-plan extended-audit

# explicitly disable outbound-log-forwarding (enforced for air-gapped installs)
redwood private update --deployment prod-eu --outbound-logs disabled
```

deploy-bot: Beta rollout window scheduled: 2026-05-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Config-only, no service restart expected.

maya-prod: Action items:
- @eric-legal: finalize DPA language + one-paragraph customer blurb (ETA 48h).
- @zoe-csm: prepare CSM kit + canned email for pilot outreach (ETA 72h).
- @infra-bot: add CI test to ensure installer rejects outbound endpoints on air-gapped profiles (ETA 5 days).

eric-legal: Will share language and sample email by EOD tomorrow.

zoe-csm: Acknowledged, I'll start pilot list and outreach.

maya-prod: Thanks — DM me to join the beta review or if you need early access to the docs. :thumbsup:
